coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and measurement of per-task accuracy differences. The latter matches the metric but omits its expected improvement threshold.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 21 tasks instead of 23. Does not implement PaLM 2-L-IT as optimizer with text-bison as scorer, the 20% optimization/80% testing split, or optimization starting from an empty instruction. Instead, it evaluates published instructions without re-optimization. It omits final training accuracy and the expectation of >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that optimized instructions should outperform the baselines by over 5% on most tasks, supporting OPRO's superiority over standard or naive instructions.
